quarantine.rule: Q1: a MeetingQA question is usable only when its meeting's registry role is 'qa-eval'. Every other MeetingQA question straddles roles and is quarantined.

roles.asr-eval: G1 flight set: chunked transcription + attribution scoring.
roles.glossary-discovery: Glossary/term-mining discovery surface; never scored as eval.
roles.held-out-confirmatory: Frozen eval-16. No exposure, no scoring, no discovery. Ever.
roles.held-out-reserve: Held-out remainder with no assigned role. No exposure.
roles.qa-eval: MeetingQA evaluation surface. The only role whose questions are usable.
